insights.headline: Gold holds above $4,130 as MCX gold adds Rs 6,400 in two sessions ahead of Dhanteras
insights.summary: Spot gold rose 1.9% to $4,134.83 an ounce on Thursday, its highest since October 22, extending Wednesday's ~3.4% midterm rally as a weaker dollar and lower Treasury yields followed the Democrats' congressional sweep, Reuters reports. Spot silver rose 1.7% to $53.12. On MCX, gold added about Rs 6,400 per 10 g and silver about Rs 11,231 per kg over two sessions. Dhanteras falls on November 6, and jewellers expect flat volumes but 30% value growth; traders now await Friday's US payrolls report, with markets pricing about an 82% chance of a December Fed rate rise, per CME FedWatch via Reuters.
points: Spot gold rose 1.9% to $4,134.83, its highest since October 22, with December futures at $4,144.20, Reuters reports.
MCX gold added Rs 6,400/10 g and silver Rs 11,231/kg in two sessions; December gold futures Rs 1,45,909/10 g, ET reports.
Jewellery stocks rose with bullion: Senco +3.7%, PC Jeweller +3.2% and Titan +2.3%, Mint reports.
Dhanteras is November 6; gold is up ~192% since Dhanteras 2021 but down over 22% from its ~Rs 1,80,000 high, ET reports.
Friday's US October payrolls report is the next test; traders price roughly an 82% chance of a December Fed hike, per CME FedWatch via Reuters.

brief.headline: Gold stays above $4,000 as midterm sweep sinks dollar
brief.summary: Gold stayed near $4,083 after a 3.4% surge on a sliding dollar; MCX gold near Rs 1.43 lakh/10 g before Dhanteras.

bullets.text: Reuters notes the dollar retreated on the Democrats' sweep, aiding bullion; Kitco says the dollar, not the election result, steers metals.
Dhanteras is November 6; GJC's Rokde told PTI jewellers expect flat volumes but ~30% value growth; the rupee rose a third day to 94.75.
US payrolls Friday (7 PM IST) is the next Fed catalyst; December hike odds near 83% per CME, and the dollar reaction will swing gold.

trending.title: Gold extends rally to two-week high on softer dollar and yields
trending.summary: Gold held above $4,100 as the dollar slid to a five-week low and yields fell after the Democrats' midterm sweep, with MCX gold adding Rs 6,400 per 10 g in two sessions.

trending.title: Silver eyes breakout as yields retreat
trending.summary: Silver rose to $53.12 as bond yields retreated, and analysts see a bullish breakout building; MCX silver added Rs 11,231 per kg in two sessions.

trending.title: Citi's $5,000 call hinges on Hormuz and a Fed pivot
trending.summary: Citi sees gold at $5,000 in 6-12 months if the Strait of Hormuz reopens and lower oil flips the Fed from hikes to cuts.

trending.title: Dhanteras eve: Delhi prices rebound, jewellers bet on lightweight
trending.summary: Delhi gold rebounded Rs 4,800 to Rs 1,46,600 per 10 g ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, with jewellers expecting flat volumes but about 30% higher value as buyers favour lighter pieces.

trending.title: India's Q3 demand slump deepens as central banks buy more
trending.summary: India's Q3 gold demand fell 29% as high prices restrained buying, while global central banks bought 321 tonnes, the fastest pace since 2024, the World Gold Council says.

items.title: Gold prices jump Rs 6,500/10 gram in 2 days; silver soars Rs 11,200/kg as soft dollar, fall oil boost mood
items.summary: MCX gold added about Rs 6,400 per 10 g and silver about Rs 11,231 per kg over two sessions, with December gold futures at Rs 1,45,909 per 10 g, the Economic Times reports. Spot gold rose 1.9% to $4,134.83 an ounce, its highest since October 22, and spot silver 1.7% to $53.12, as a weaker dollar, falling US yields and crude oil down about 10% followed the Democrats' midterm sweep.

items.title: Gold hits a two-week high as dollar, Treasury yields ease after US midterm elections
items.summary: Spot gold rose 1.9% to $4,134.83 an ounce on Thursday, its highest since October 22, as a weaker dollar and lower Treasury yields followed the Democrats' midterm sweep, Reuters reports. December futures rose 1.8% to $4,144.20 and spot silver rose 1.7% to $53.12. Traders await Friday's payrolls, pricing an 82% chance of a December Fed rise, per CME FedWatch.

Gold topped $4,100 on Thursday, extending Wednesday's midterm rally as Democratic wins fed hopes of ending the US-Iran conflict and sank oil, Trading Economics reports. Weaker dollar and falling yields added support; Trump conceded the war cost Republicans, signalling no immediate Iran escalation. Friday's US payrolls is next; a 79% December Fed hike is priced per CME FedWatch.
items.title: Gold climbs above $4,100 on US-Iran de-escalation hopes after midterm sweep
US Midterm Election Results Impact on Gold, Silver Jewellery Stocks: Senco, PC, Titan shares shine on Trump's loss
items.summary: Jewellery stocks rose as bullion rebounded, Mint reports: Senco Gold gained 3.7% to Rs 322.65, PC Jeweller 3.2% to Rs 16.32, Titan 2.3% to Rs 4,858.90 and Kalyan 2.7% to Rs 544.70. MCX gold traded at Rs 1,46,109 per 10 g and silver at Rs 1,90,946 per kg, with spot gold at $4,134.83 an ounce, as a weaker dollar and lower Treasury yields followed the Democrats' midterm win.

Gold extended its midterm rally in early Asian trade, rising 0.6% to $4,082.76 after Wednesday's ~3.4% surge — its biggest daily gain since August — as the Democrats' congressional sweep sank the dollar. US gold futures added 0.5% to $4,092.90 and spot silver rose 0.3% to $52.37, with traders now awaiting Friday's US payrolls report while CME FedWatch puts December hike odds near 83%.
items.title: Gold rises after biggest daily gain since August, with US payrolls in focus

items.summary: Spot gold climbed 3% to $4,046.74 an ounce on Wednesday — its biggest daily gain since August 19 — as the dollar slid after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in the midterms. December gold futures rose 2.9% to $4,054.60. Capital Economics' Hamad Hussain said fiscal worries supported bullion, but a likely hawkish Fed could cap gains, with Friday's US payrolls report the next test.
items.title: Gold gains 3% as dollar slides after Democratic midterm gains

items.summary: Silver is testing downtrend resistance from late-September highs after reclaiming $51.27 and $52.67, with gold's breakout from its own September downtrend lighting the way, FOREX.com's technical analysis says. The metals' 10-day correlation is +0.99 with silver's beta near 1.7, so a confirmed breakout could target $54.78-$58.50; $51.27-$52.67 must hold, with $48.86 the key support below.
items.title: Silver's bullish breakout case builds as bond yields retreat

items.summary: Delhi bullion rebounded two days before Dhanteras: gold of 99.9% purity rose Rs 4,800 to Rs 1,46,600 per 10 g and silver jumped Rs 9,000 to Rs 1.93 lakh per kg, inclusive of taxes, the All India Sarafa Association said. Spot gold climbed 3% to $4,043.93 an ounce, back above $4,000, with HDFC Securities' Saumil Gandhi citing the strong global recovery and improving festive demand.
items.title: Gold climbs Rs 4,800 to Rs 1.46 lakh/10 gm in Delhi; silver surges Rs 9,000

items.summary: MCX December gold rose 2.42% to Rs 1,42,820 per 10 g and silver jumped 4.28% to Rs 1,87,397 per kg as of 3:50 PM IST, as the dollar slid on US midterms showing a Democratic sweep of Congress. Jewellery stocks rallied with the metals — Sky Gold up 6.5%, Titan 4.2%, Kalyan 4.1% — while Thangamayil fell 5.5%. Univest cites WGC data showing gold rose in 62% of six-month windows after past midterms.
items.title: US Midterm Elections Jewellery Stocks, Gold and Silver Rates
Gold's 192% Dhanteras rally: Rs 92,000 jump in five years, but can the yellow metal reclaim its lost shine in 2027?
items.summary: Domestic gold has risen about 192% since Dhanteras 2021, from roughly Rs 47,904 to about Rs 1,40,000 per 10 g in late October, but is still down more than 22% from its all-time high near Rs 1,80,000, the Economic Times reports. Silver is down more than 56% from its late-January record. Bank forecasts cited include Standard Chartered at $4,650 an ounce in Q4 and Goldman Sachs at $5,400 in 2027.

items.title: Buying gold this Dhanteras? What investors should keep in mind
items.summary: Ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, CNBC-TV18 notes gold prices have corrected and sets out what buyers check before purchasing: purity, BIS hallmarking, weight and making charges. The piece cites US bond yields, the dollar, inflation and geopolitics, plus the rupee and import duties at home, as the forces shaping prices, and quotes MMTC-PAMP on systematic buying.

Gold and silver extended Wednesday's gains on a weaker dollar, lower yields and geopolitical uncertainty: MCX December gold rose 1.76% to Rs 1,41,911/10g and December silver advanced 3.09% to Rs 1,85,249/kg, recovering from an early-session slide, IANS reports. COMEX gold was $3,963.20/oz, silver $49.99/oz; traders still see a 78% chance of a December Fed hike.
items.title: Gold, silver surge up to 3 pc over weaker US dollar, geopolitical uncertainty
The dollar decides: What the midterm rally in gold and silver says about the next turn
items.summary: Kitco argues the dollar, not the election result, steers bullion: past midterm waves moved gold oppositely because the dollar did. The dollar index slid to a five-week low near 101.2 after the Democratic sweep, with gold futures near $4,073; Capital Economics notes a hawkish Fed still limits gains, and Friday's payrolls is the next catalyst.

Jewellers are upbeat on Dhanteras sales on November 6 after gold's 12% price correction lifted sentiment, GJC chairman Rajesh Rokde told PTI. Demand is shifting to lightweight jewellery and small-ticket purchases, while silver coins gain traction with a 10% volume rise expected. Sales volumes should stay flat, but in value terms the industry expects about 30% growth.
items.title: Why Jewellers Expect Strong Dhanteras Sales Amid Recent Gold Price Drop

items.summary: Citi has set a 0-3 month gold target of $4,500 an ounce and a 6-12 month target of $5,000, according to Reuters, betting a Strait of Hormuz reopening and Yemen/Saudi de-escalation by year-end will sink oil prices. Max Layton, Citi's global head of commodities research, said much lower oil could shift the Fed from hiking to cutting rates, reviving gold investment demand.
items.title: Citi targets $5,000 gold as a Hormuz reopening could flip the Fed from hikes to cuts

items.summary: Central banks bought ~320 tonnes in Q3, up 42% on the year and ~675t so far in 2026, the WGC said — offsetting a 17% slump in jewellery consumption to ~310t, the weakest Q3 in the series, and a 19% fall in bar and coin demand. Gold averaged ~$4,260/oz; total demand was ~1,370t (-1%), with YTD demand level with 2025’s record.
items.title: Central bank gold buying jumps 42% in Q3 as high prices hit jewellery demand, WGC says

items.summary: India's gold demand fell 29% year-on-year to 162.5 tonnes in Q3 2026 as record-high prices curbed buying, WGC said. Jewellery demand dropped 20% to 99.9 tonnes; bar and coin buying fell 40% to 55 tonnes. In value terms demand still rose 3% to ₹2.42 lakh crore on an average Q3 price of $4,262 an ounce (₹1,48,891 per 10g). WGC pegs 2026 full-year demand at 625–675 tonnes, a six-year low.
items.title: India's Gold Demand Falls 29% in Q3 as High Prices Restrain Buying

items.summary: The World Gold Council halved its 2026 gold investment demand growth forecast to 200 tonnes from 400 tonnes on sharply slower bar-and-coin buying, though it raised its central-bank buying forecast. Q3 gold ETF inflows were 211 tonnes; spot hit a one-year low last Friday, down 29% from January's $5,595 record (Reuters).
items.title: WGC cuts 2026 gold investment growth forecast

items.summary: December silver futures on MCX resumed their losing streak on Tuesday after reports of a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island sent crude higher, reviving inflation fears and rate-hike expectations. Silver futures slipped ₹8,528 per kg to their lowest since late November 2025, while gold fell ₹2,000 per 10 grams, erasing Monday's brief rebound.
items.title: Silver prices crash ₹8,500/kg, gold drops ₹2,000/10g as US-Iran tensions revive inflation fears; is more fall ahead?

items.summary: The World Gold Council says India's informal gold imports surged more than 1,500% to 50 tonnes in the September quarter, from 3 tonnes a year earlier, the highest since 2023, citing Metals Focus data. The grey market has flourished since May's duty hike to 15%, and jewellers are holding back on restocking ahead of Diwali while more households buy for cash without invoices.
items.title: India's tax hike drives illegal gold imports to 3-year high

items.summary: Gold rallied to a six-day high of $4,070 on Wednesday after the Democrats' midterm sweep and is testing trend resistance near the 20-day moving average around $4,075, FXEmpire's technical analysis notes. A sustained move above the recent swing high near $4,082 would signal a bullish reversal, with further resistance at $4,155 and then the October swing high of $4,217.
items.title: Gold (XAU/USD) Price Forecast: Post-Election Rally Tests Critical Resistance

items.summary: MCX's Q2 FY27 net profit more than doubled to ₹455 crore from ₹197 crore a year ago, with total income rising to ₹800 crore on record trading volumes. Futures average daily turnover rose to ₹62,819 crore; the exchange handled physical delivery of 5.68 tonnes of gold and 199.91 tonnes of silver during the quarter.
items.title: MCX Q2 profit jumps over two-fold to ₹455 crore as trading volumes surge

items.summary: The rupee strengthened for a third straight session, settling at 94.75 per dollar after opening at 94.68 versus a 94.90 previous close, supported by foreign fund inflows into domestic equities. Gains were capped by rebounding crude — Brent rallied to $106.07 a barrel after a US attack on Iran — and the currency has gained 1.14% so far this quarter on regulatory measures.
items.title: Rupee extends gains for third day, settles at 94.75 against the dollar

items.summary: Jewellery stocks traded higher in Wednesday morning trade ahead of Dhanteras on November 6: Titan was up over 1% at Rs 4,612.40, PC Jeweller rose nearly 3% to Rs 15.12 and Senco Gold added 1.42%. The piece cites strong September-quarter business updates and management commentary pointing to a healthy festive and wedding-season demand outlook.
items.title: Dhanteras 2026: How Titan, PC Jeweller, Senco Gold stocks are shaping up ahead of the big day

items.summary: Two days before Dhanteras, Upstox lists six charges buyers should watch beyond the quoted gold rate: making charges, wastage, 3% GST, the BIS hallmarking fee raised to Rs 75 per article in September 2026, stone charges on studded pieces, and buy-back deductions generally not recovered on resale.
items.title: Buying gold this Dhanteras? 6 extra charges that could increase your jewellery bill

items.summary: Experts at Business Standard Hindi's Samvat webinar said India's long-term growth story stays strong, with investment opportunities across mutual funds, equities and gold, advising investors to keep a balanced portfolio as the new Samvat year begins.
items.title: New Samvat brings opportunities in mutual funds, equities and gold: Experts
